reproduction_scripts.capture_doss_comparison.gd:
extends "res://tests/capture_activity_lures.gd"
## DRY RUN: staged arrival and pinned clock, paired private material candidates.
var _filtered_maps: Dictionary = {}

func _run() -> void:
	await process_frame
	root.size = Vector2i(1920, 1080)
	await super._run()

func _walk() -> void:
	_receipt["script_state_writes"] = "DRY RUN: staged arrival and day/night clock; private material overrides; no flag/inventory writes"
	var at := _lure_body.global_position + Vector3(3, 0, 2)
	_player.global_position = Vector3(at.x, float(_world.call("ground_height_at", at.x, at.z)) + 0.5, at.z)
	_player.velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	for i in 90:
		await physics_frame
	await _walk_straight_to(_lure_body.global_position, 1.8, _prompt)
	await _face_lure()
	await _perform_action()
	_finish("PASS", "staged arrival; paired visual material comparison only")

func _capture_perch(perch: Node3D, label: String) -> void:
	var stowed := false
	if _director != null and _director.call("ally_body") != null:
		await _press("creature_recall")
		for i in 60:
			await physics_frame
		stowed = _director.call("ally_body") == null
	await _face_point(perch.global_position)
	var surfaces: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for node: Node in perch.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
		var mi := node as MeshInstance3D
		for surface in mi.mesh.get_surface_count():
			var source := mi.get_active_material(surface) as StandardMaterial3D
			if source == null or source.resource_name != "MI_WoodTrim": continue
			var candidate := source.duplicate() as StandardMaterial3D
			candidate.albedo_color = Color("#7a5636")
			candidate.metallic = 0.0
			var filtered := source.duplicate() as StandardMaterial3D
			filtered.texture_filter = BaseMaterial3D.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS_ANISOTROPIC
			filtered.albedo_texture = _mip_texture(source.albedo_texture)
			filtered.normal_texture = _mip_texture(source.normal_texture, true)
			filtered.roughness_texture = _mip_texture(source.roughness_texture)
			var filtered_tint := filtered.duplicate() as StandardMaterial3D
			filtered_tint.albedo_color = Color("#7a5636")
			filtered_tint.metallic = 0.0
			var no_normal := source.duplicate() as StandardMaterial3D
			no_normal.normal_enabled = false
			surfaces.append({"mesh":mi, "surface":surface, "source":mi.get_surface_override_material(surface), "candidate":candidate,"filtered":filtered,"filtered_tint":filtered_tint,"no_normal":no_normal})
	print("[doss-material] wood surfaces=%d state=%s" % [surfaces.size(), label])
	var look := _world.get_node("WorldLook")
	for time_name in ["day", "night"]:
		look.call("set_clock_frozen", false)
		look.call("apply_time", time_name)
		look.call("set_clock_frozen", true)
		for i in 30: await physics_frame
		for variant in ["control", "candidate", "filtered", "filtered_tint", "no_normal"]:
			for s: Dictionary in surfaces:
				(s.mesh as MeshInstance3D).set_surface_override_material(s.surface, s.source if variant == "control" else s[variant])
			await _capture("%s-%s-%s" % [label,time_name,variant])
	for s: Dictionary in surfaces:
		(s.mesh as MeshInstance3D).set_surface_override_material(s.surface, s.source)
	look.call("set_clock_frozen", false)
	look.call("apply_time", "day")
	look.call("set_clock_frozen", true)
	if stowed: await _ensure_companion_out("%s; " % label)

func _mip_texture(texture: Texture2D, normal := false) -> Texture2D:
	if texture == null: return null
	if _filtered_maps.has(texture): return _filtered_maps[texture]
	var image := texture.get_image()
	print("[doss-material] source=%s mips=%s format=%d" % [texture.resource_path, image.has_mipmaps(),image.get_format()])
	if image.is_compressed(): image.decompress()
	image.generate_mipmaps(normal)
	var filtered := ImageTexture.create_from_image(image)
	_filtered_maps[texture] = filtered
	return filtered
reproduction_scripts.capture_doss_production.gd:
extends "res://tests/capture_activity_lures.gd"
## DRY RUN: production imports versus private copies with their mip chain removed.
var _unfiltered_maps: Dictionary = {}

func _run() -> void:
	await process_frame
	root.size = Vector2i(1920, 1080)
	await super._run()

func _walk() -> void:
	_receipt["script_state_writes"] = "DRY RUN: staged arrival and day/night clock; private no-mipmap control; no flag/inventory writes"
	await _stage(_lure_body.global_position + Vector3(3,0,2))
	await _walk_straight_to(_lure_body.global_position, 1.8, _prompt)
	await _face_lure()
	await _perform_action()
	if _director != null and _director.call("ally_body") != null:
		await _press("creature_recall")
	for stand: Dictionary in [
		{"name":"shop", "at":Vector3(10,0,10), "face":Vector3(18,1,4)},
		{"name":"workshop", "at":Vector3(14,0,18), "face":Vector3(2,2,12)},
		{"name":"well", "at":Vector3(4,0,-2), "face":Vector3(10,1,-10)}]:
		await _stage(stand.at)
		_rig.set("pitch", deg_to_rad(-15.0))
		await _face_point(stand.face)
		for time_name in ["day","night"]:
			await _set_time(time_name)
			await _pair(_world,"village-%s-%s" % [stand.name,time_name])
	_finish("PASS", "paired production wood imports, Doss repair and village material samples; staged DRY RUN")

func _stage(at: Vector3) -> void:
	_player.global_position = Vector3(at.x,float(_world.call("ground_height_at",at.x,at.z))+0.5,at.z)
	_player.velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	for i in 90: await physics_frame

func _set_time(time_name: String) -> void:
	var look := _world.get_node("WorldLook")
	look.call("set_clock_frozen",false)
	look.call("apply_time",time_name)
	look.call("set_clock_frozen",true)
	for i in 30: await physics_frame

func _capture_perch(perch: Node3D, label: String) -> void:
	var stowed := false
	if _director != null and _director.call("ally_body") != null:
		await _press("creature_recall")
		for i in 60: await physics_frame
		stowed = _director.call("ally_body") == null
	await _face_point(perch.global_position)
	for time_name in ["day","night"]:
		await _set_time(time_name)
		await _pair(perch,"%s-%s" % [label,time_name])
	await _set_time("day")
	if stowed: await _ensure_companion_out("%s; " % label)

func _pair(target: Node3D, label: String) -> void:
	var surfaces: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for node: Node in target.find_children("*","MeshInstance3D",true,false):
		var mi := node as MeshInstance3D
		if mi.mesh == null: continue
		for surface in mi.mesh.get_surface_count():
			var source := mi.get_active_material(surface) as StandardMaterial3D
			if source == null or source.resource_name != "MI_WoodTrim": continue
			if source.albedo_texture == null or not source.albedo_texture.resource_path.contains("quaternius_medieval/T_WoodTrim_"): continue
			var control := source.duplicate() as StandardMaterial3D
			control.albedo_texture = _without_mips(source.albedo_texture)
			control.normal_texture = _without_mips(source.normal_texture)
			control.roughness_texture = _without_mips(source.roughness_texture)
			surfaces.append({"mesh":mi,"surface":surface,"source":mi.get_surface_override_material(surface),"control":control})
	print("[wood-import] state=%s surfaces=%d camera=%s feet=%s" % [label,surfaces.size(),root.get_camera_3d().global_position,_player.global_position])
	for variant in ["control","production"]:
		for s: Dictionary in surfaces:
			(s.mesh as MeshInstance3D).set_surface_override_material(s.surface,s.control if variant == "control" else s.source)
		await _capture("%s-%s" % [label,variant])

func _without_mips(texture: Texture2D) -> Texture2D:
	if texture == null: return null
	if _unfiltered_maps.has(texture): return _unfiltered_maps[texture]
	var image := texture.get_image()
	print("[wood-import] source=%s mips=%s levels=%d filter=original" % [texture.resource_path,image.has_mipmaps(),image.get_mipmap_count()])
	assert(image.has_mipmaps(),"Production texture must contain mipmaps")
	if image.is_compressed(): image.decompress()
	image.clear_mipmaps()
	var control := ImageTexture.create_from_image(image)
	_unfiltered_maps[texture] = control
	return control
